name: Avant Group Corporation
summary: Avant Group Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides accounting, business intelligence, and outsourcing services in Japan. The company develops and maintains DivaSystem, a package software for consolidated management and accounting. It also provides information search services; system integration services for the utilization of information known as BI (business intelligence), and cloud data platform implementation support services; software license and hardware sales and maintenance; sales and maintenance of software licenses and hardware; and outsourcing services for consolidated accounting, consolidated financial statement disclosure business, as well as digital transformation promo…
